blocks.text: FSH barhne se chand ovarian follicles barhna shuru karte hain, magar sirf ek follicle poora barhta hai aur baqi khatam (degenerate) ho jate hain. Yeh pakka hua follicle Graafian follicle kehlata hai aur ovary ki sateh par ubhar aata hai.

FSH Graafian follicle se estrogen hormones chhurwata hai. Estrogen endometrium mein khoon ki nalyan banana (vascularization) shuru karta hai aur use dobara makhmali (velvety) aur mota kar deta hai. Jaise jaise estrogen barhta hai, negative feedback se FSH girta hai. Jab estrogen ki satah bohat zyada ho jati hai to yeh hypothalamus aur anterior pituitary par positive feedback karta hai, aur anterior pituitary achanak bohat sa LH chhorta hai. Yeh proliferative phase ke aakhir (din 14) par hota hai. Anterior pituitary se LH ka achanak chhootna (LH surge) Graafian follicle se ovum ko oviduct mein chhurwata hai. Is phase ko ovulation kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai estrogen barhne par FSH girta hai is liye LH chhoot'ta hai. FSH ka girna LH nahin chhurwata. Zyada tar hawalon ke mutabiq ovulation se zara pehle estrogen ki zyada aur musalsal satah hi LH ka ubhaar laati hai (pituitary par positive feedback), aur saath FSH ka chhota ubhaar hota hai. Khaaka yahi aam namoona dikhata hai.

blocks.alt: Ovary ki tarash, baen taraf se khoon ki nalyan dakhil hoti hain. Marahil ghari ki sui ki simt (clockwise) tarteeb mein, bahar teer: primary oocytes wale primary follicles, mae (fluid) wali jagah banate developing follicles, secondary oocyte wala bara Graafian follicle, phata hua (ruptured) follicle jis se released ovum ovary se nikalta hai, phir early corpus luteum, corpus luteum aur sukarta hua (regressed) corpus luteum.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ovary ke khaake ko oopar baen se shuru kar ke ghari ki sui ki simt parhein, bahar ke gulabi teeron ke saath. Chhota primary follicle barhta hai, us mein mae ki jagah banti hai aur woh Graafian follicle ban jata hai. Ovulation par Graafian follicle phat kar secondary oocyte (released ovum) bahar chhorta hai. Phata hua follicle LH ke asar se peela corpus luteum ban jata hai, jo estrogen aur progesterone banata hai. Fertilization na ho to corpus luteum sukar kar khatam (regressed) ho jata hai.
